_comment: Scenario config: AgentX / DeepSeek-V4 / TP8 / global conc=10, aligned with CI run 34783501425. Layered on top of default.json. Every site-local absolute path appears here and nowhere in the code.

runner_env._comment: env_file points at a credential file **outside the repo** (mode 600); only the path appears here, never the key. This cluster authenticates through the AMD gateway rather than ~/.claude credentials. If the file is missing the runner returns 78 and the worker stops immediately instead of burning budget on retries that cannot succeed. See runners/claude.env.example for the template.

params._note_receipt: A full reproduction of CI run 34783501425: 446.87889 tok/s against a CI reference of 446.56324 (0.07% apart), 1455 successes / 0 errors, TP8/EP1, 8 GPUs, global conc=10, MTP 5-6-1.
params._note_node: The receipt does not record a node name. Fill in `node` if you know which machine it was, otherwise applyback will warn about cross-node risk.

params.selection: per-phase Top 5 AND overall GPU-time share > 3%
params._note_window: The capture window must land in steady state, not in the ramp. This scenario once captured a window with prefill:decode = 32:7 while the true ratio was 1:1119 — ranking on raw window percentages would have routed the entire kernel budget at prefill.

params._note_arch: The arch JSON is not a constant. This cluster carries four MI355X variants whose bf16 peaks spread by 18.6%. Which arch JSON, its md5, and the peak key it parsed must appear in every row's provenance.
params._note_mode: rocprof, not tl-only: TraceLens carries no native perf model for any of the three selected operators (has_perf_model=false on every captured case), so tl-only can emit no roofline_us for them. rocprof measures instead of predicting and does not need one.
params._note_ceilings: The installed rocprof-compute is 3.4.0, below the 3.6.0 gate: its gfx950 MFMA microbench emits CDNA3 instructions and reads 2-4x low. Its COUNTERS are fine, so the ceilings are supplied instead from a frozen roofline.csv measured by the 3.6.0 microbench run standalone (scripts/new_mibench.py), via ROOFLINE_MIBENCH_CACHE. HBM read bytes are corrected by scripts/rocprof_hbm_patch.py (gfx950 FETCH_SIZE bills 128B reads at 64B through a TCC_BUBBLE that is identically 0).

params._note_cap: Short attempts chained through apply_to_original. Measured: a 2 h cap gave 69 attempts / 11 keeps (16%); a 1500 s cap gave 85 attempts / 22 keeps (26%), in under half the wall-clock.
params._note_keep: 1.045 comes from measurement, not from the 1.02 in the documentation: in the previous campaign four kernels whose source was md5-identical to the original re-measured at 1.0246-1.0453 from cold.
params._note_budget: 4 h per unit test for this campaign (the skill default is 48 h). With a 1500 s attempt cap that is ~9-10 chained attempts per kernel.
params._note_image: Same image as the pristine CI stack the profile stage extracted against, so the kernel being optimized is the kernel that ships.

params._note_exclusive: End-to-end re-measurement needs the full 8-GPU serving stack (TP8/conc10). Once it starts it owns the whole machine and cannot run alongside optimize.
params._note_gap: An operator win with no end-to-end movement has already happened twice in this scenario: FlyDSL MoE sorting measured 1.80x on the microbenchmark and +0.2356% whole-machine; MoE split4 measured 1.342x on local replay and -0.0872% whole-machine. Operator speedup and end-to-end delta must be reported as two separate numbers.
